posts.title: Max-Width, Margin Auto
posts.description: You can make good websites without being a CSS expert, writing a ton of code, or using a massive framework. There are a few simple things you can do to make a website feel like a "real" website and today we're going to start with number one: limit line length. posts.description: In 2026, I am going to learn basic ASL.
